services.name: Snorkel Rentals
services.desc: Regularly $70 each for the week but with our 2 for 1 weekly special you get two sets for $70, which makes them $35 each. AND get an extra week free when you rent for a week. Keep your gear for up to 14 days. Whether you are a first-time snorkeler or this is your twentieth time snorkeling on Maui, the EZ Breathe is the set for you. Watch the EZ Breathe vs standard snorkel video to compare the two. Water travels out of the purge valve instead of into your mouth. Snorkel comparison video. Featuring the same great fitted silicone mask, the EZ Breathe set is the best gear you can rent, because the snorkel is exceptional. We use the Aqua Lung Impulse II dry snorkel invented by Jacques Cousteau!

services.name: Boat Tours
services.desc: Embark on the Lanai Snorkeling Tour, leaving the tranquil shores of Maui to discover the pristine waters of Lanai. Dive into crystal-clear blue seas and immerse yourself in the vibrant marine life. Indulge in a delightful Dinner Cruise, serenaded by island-style melodies and surrounded by breathtaking ocean vistas as you savor beloved island beverages. It's an idyllic setting to witness the mesmerizing sunset of Maui. Set sail on a humpback whale watching expedition, where informative commentary accompanies your journey to the heart of these majestic creatures' habitat. Experience the wonders of Turtle Town snorkeling, renowned as Maui's ultimate spot for encountering the majestic Hawaiian
